info.title: Sheetbase service-credential API
info.description:
Service-credential API for Sheetbase v0.1.

Authenticate with `POST /api/token`, then call `/api/db/*` with the returned JWT as `Authorization: Bearer`.
Only operations an API key can complete are listed. Unknown paths fail closed.

Errors: `POST /api/token` returns `{ error: { code, message } }`. `/api/db/*` returns `{ error: { category, message, request_id? } }`. Do not expect `code` on the data path.

Human-session-only (not callable with an API key): `submit_record_revision`, `run_revision_checks`, `sign_revision`, `create_amendment` and other review-transition writers.
`reviews:write` is mintable but does not open submit, sign, or amend.
`reviews:read` opens `preview_submission_digest` only.

Schema-authoring RPCs, file RPCs, and scientific-table REST are not part of this API.
DELETE on `projects` is not granted to `api_client`.

Narrative contract: `docs/public-api-contract.md`. How to call this spec: `docs/openapi/README.md`. Credential mechanics: `docs/external-api.md`.

post.description: Unauthenticated. Body `{ credential, scopes }` → `{ token }`. Failures use `TokenError` (`error.code`), never `error.category`.

get.description:
GET `blocks` through PostgREST.

Pagination: `limit` and `offset` query parameters.

Sort: `order=column.asc` or `column.desc`; repeat `order` for multiple columns.

Filters: `{column}={operator}.{value}` where operator is one of `eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in, is, cs, cd, ov, fts, plfts, phfts, wfts, not`. Examples: `id=eq.<uuid>`, `kind=eq.experiment`, `status=in.(draft,in-progress)`.

Logic: `and=(status.eq.draft,kind.eq.experiment)` and `or=(...)`.

Count: send header `Prefer: count=exact` (optionally with `Range: 0-0` or `limit=0`) and read the total from `Content-Range`.

Column selection: `select=id,title`.

200.description: JSON array of `blocks` rows. With `Prefer: count=exact`, `Content-Range` is `start-end/total` (e.g. `0-24/123`).

Content-Range.description: Present when Prefer: count=* is honoured. Total is the number after the slash.

206.description: Partial content when a `Range` header is used.

403.description: `permission_denied` — missing scope, revoked credential, or RLS

head.description: Same query string and `Prefer` / `Range` headers as GET. Use with `Prefer: count=exact` to obtain `Content-Range` without a body.

200.description: JSON array of `blocks` rows. With `Prefer: count=exact`, `Content-Range` is `start-end/total` (e.g. `0-24/123`).

Content-Range.description: Present when Prefer: count=* is honoured. Total is the number after the slash.

206.description: Partial content when a `Range` header is used.

403.description: `permission_denied` — missing scope, revoked credential, or RLS

post.description: PostgREST INSERT. Prefer domain RPCs when one exists (records, blocks, links). Filter mutations with `id=eq.<uuid>`.

schema.description: Columns of `blocks`.

bearerAuth.description: JWT from POST /api/token. Claims: workspace_id, credential_id, scopes, role=api_client. Default TTL 300s.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Combine with `offset`. `limit=0` with `Prefer: count=exact` returns no rows and a total in `Content-Range`.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of rows to skip. Use with `limit`.

Order.name: order
Order.description: Sort. Repeat the parameter for multiple columns, e.g. `order=archived_at.asc&order=identifier.asc`. Suffix `.nullsfirst` / `.nullslast` when needed.

ColumnFilter.name: {column}
ColumnFilter.description: Any snake_case column on this table may be sent as a filter. Value form: `{operator}.{argument}`. Operators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in, is, cs, cd, ov, fts, plfts, phfts, wfts, not. Examples: `id=eq.00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101`, `kind=eq.experiment`, `created_at=gte.2026-01-01`, `status=in.(draft,in-progress)`, `title=ilike.*stability*`. Negate with `not`, e.g. `status=not.eq.archived`. Query keys must match `^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.]*$` and values are capped at 500 characters by the proxy.

Prefer.name: Prefer
Prefer.description: PostgREST Prefer. For counts: `count=exact` (also `count=planned`, `count=estimated`). For writes: `return=representation` to receive inserted/updated rows. The proxy forwards this header unchanged on credential requests.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: Row range. `Range: 0-0` with `Prefer: count=exact` is the cheap total-count pattern (`Content-Range: 0-0/total`).

RangeUnit.name: Range-Unit
RangeUnit.description: Usually `items`. Forwarded to PostgREST when present.

request_id.description: Correlation id from `x-request-id` or generated by the proxy.
